dct_description_sm: The purpose of this project is to strengthen the adaptive capacity of the communities of Ekuanitshit and Essipi by undergoing the following activities: (1) mobilize decision-makers, managers, and community members for climate change adaptation; (2) conduct a vulnerability assessment and determine capacity of adaptation to climate change impacts for both communities; (3) develop a climate change adaptation plan; and (4) reinforce the capacity of local decision-makers to implement their climate change adaptation plans.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Capacity building
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Community vulnerability
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Community infrastructure
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Traditional Ecological Knowledge (TEK)
dct_title_s: Planification de l'adaptation aux changements climatiques dans les communauts innues d'Essipit et de Ekuanitshit
